searchText: EEST Pre-Release for Devnet-4: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/pectra-devnet-4%40v1.0.0 Please take a look into the breaking changes for the consumption of the included fixtures! The format has been change to take into account the specification changes in EIP-7685, more details in the release notes, but let me know if you need extra info. i think these should say `if block_body_override is not None` https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/blob/397c21a26653cb924ce4638d0a906c7686fd01da/tests/prague/eip7002_el_triggerable_withdrawals/test_withdrawal_requests.py#L722 https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/blob/397c21a26653cb924ce4638d0a906c7686fd01da/tests/prague/eip7251_consolidations/test_consolidations.py#L773 otherwise it will not put the override header and there we'll accept the block as the `requestsHash` is correct unless others are passing and i’m missing something? I think you are right, let me check this It should only affect negative tests that swap a non-empty list for an empty list Transaction Fixture Tests (t9n) Made a second release with this fix: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/pectra-devnet-4%40v1.0.1

excerpts.content:
Please take a look into the breaking changes for the consumption of the included fixtures!
The format has been change to take into account the specification changes in EIP-7685, more details in the release notes, but let me know if you need extra info.

excerpts.content:
i think these should say `if block_body_override is not None`

https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/blob/397c21a26653cb924ce4638d0a906c7686fd01da/tests/prague/eip7002_el_triggerable_withdrawals/test_withdrawal_requests.py#L722

otherwise it will not put the override header and there we'll accept the block as the `requestsHash` is correct
